exposed.name: Lights
exposed.doc: How many lights round the rose.

exposed.name: Inner radius
exposed.doc: The net's inner circle; each light's sill stands half a bar outside it, mm.

exposed.name: Outer radius
exposed.doc: The net's outer circle; each light's apex stands half a bar inside it, mm.

exposed.name: Bar
exposed.doc: Metal between neighbouring lights and to both circles, mm.

exposed.name: Head
exposed.doc: Pointed, Round, Trefoil, or the whole light a Mouchette.

exposed.name: Width
exposed.doc: 0 fills each cell; above 0, every light is parallel-sided at this width, mm.

exposed.name: Phase
exposed.doc: The first light's axis, degrees from the sketch's x.

exposed.name: Clockwise
exposed.doc: Mouchettes lean clockwise instead of counter-clockwise.

exposed.name: Centre x
exposed.doc: Where the rose is centred along the sketch's x, mm.

exposed.name: Centre y
exposed.doc: Where the rose is centred along the sketch's y, mm.

exposed.name: Plane
exposed.doc: The work plane or part the rose lies on, by feature id.

exposed.name: Face
exposed.doc: Which planar face of that feature; a work plane has one, 0.

outputs.name: sketch_op
outputs.doc: The rose as a Sketch feature's operation, a closed loop per light.

outputs.name: count
outputs.doc: How many lights the rose drew, for an array of stones round it.

outputs.name: land_mm
outputs.doc: The narrowest metal between neighbouring lights, mm.
